concerns.text: T010's verification runs `pip install -r code/requirements.txt`, but no task in tasks.md produces `code/requirements.txt`. The plan's old T001 (scaffold + requirements.txt) was dropped in the consolidation, leaving T010 (and every task's isolated-venv execution per the constitution) consuming an artifact with no producer. Add requirements.txt creation to T001 or a dedicated setup task.

T010 is tagged [P] but its own text says it is parallel-safe only 'once T009 lands' — an implicit ordering requirement. A [P] tag must not carry a hidden sequencing condition; either drop [P] or split the quickstart (parallel-safe) from research.md (depends on T007–T009 artifacts).

T006 (integration tests for λ-switch) only depends on T002/T003, yet is placed after T005 (full 50-seed run). Not a violation, but placing it immediately after T003 would surface DOPD regressions before the expensive full run; consider reordering.
